adminDatabase.title: Database editor
adminDatabase.copy: Typed PostgreSQL records. Raw SQL and internal migration tables are unavailable.
adminDatabase.bypassCopy: Use normal admin actions whenever possible. Every direct change requires a reason, diff review, typed confirmation, and rescue backup.
adminDatabase.appliedCopy: Rescue backup {id} was created before the mutation.
adminDatabase.filterCopy: Choose up to five filters. Changes apply together.

adminBackups.title: Backups
adminBackups.copy: Verified PostgreSQL archives are retained for seven days. Restore during offline maintenance.
adminBackups.maintenanceDescription: A verified backup will be created first, then database records and migration snapshots older than seven days will be removed. You can run this again on the same day.
adminBackups.maintenanceQueued: Maintenance is queued. Backups and jobs will refresh after it completes.
adminBackups.maintenanceSucceeded: Maintenance completed. Backups and jobs have been refreshed.
adminBackups.maintenanceFailed: Maintenance failed. Check the job status and try again.
adminBackups.noneHint: The daily scheduler will create the first verified copy.
adminBackups.deleteDescription: The verified archive and its metadata are removed together. Archives protected by recovery history cannot be deleted.
adminBackups.jobsHint: Retries and scheduled entitlement changes. Continuity runs three minutes before the next term.
adminBackups.noJobsHint: Scheduled work and retries will appear here.
adminBackups.deleteJobDescription: Successful work is removed automatically. Pending, failed, and legacy completed work may be removed manually; a currently processing job remains protected.

databaseRecord.title: {action} {table} row
databaseRecord.copy: Direct edits bypass domain synchronization hooks.
databaseRecord.warning: Every direct mutation is high risk and creates a rescue backup.
databaseRecord.deleteHint: The reviewed diff must show the full row removal before apply.
databaseRecord.noEditableFields: This record has no directly editable fields.
databaseRecord.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this direct edit necessary?
